replication.target_description: Assigned replication Study 3: Mediation analysis of feelings of smallness and belief in human imperfection in the relationship between God salience and AI acceptance. Report locator p. 14, 15 & 16 is unavailable in this unpaginated letter; target correspondence unresolved.

n.location: Unpaginated supplied letter, paragraph beginning “The importance”
n.quote: We preregistered our plans and employed samples (total N = 4143) which were at least two times larger than the five original studies we replicated (N = 1531); see ref. 4 for full results, materials, data, and code.
n.sample_role: Target-specific analytic participants unresolved; N = 4143 is a pooled replication total only.
n.exclusions: Target exclusions and final groups are not documented in this summary.

es.location: Unpaginated supplied letter, results paragraph beginning “Fig. 1 shows”
es.quote: Studies 1, 2a, 2b, 3, and 5 produced effect sizes, measured by r, of 0.03, 0.02, 0.03, 0.002, and 0.01, respectively

p.location: Unpaginated supplied letter, results paragraph beginning “Fig. 1 shows”
p.quote: In our replications, the effect of God salience on AI reliance is not statistically different from zero ... Studies 1, 2a, 2b, 3, and 5 produced effect sizes, measured by r, of 0.03, 0.02, 0.03, 0.002, and 0.01, respectively ... see ref. 4 for full results, materials, data, and code.

notes: Source identity: title exactly matches the neutral Moore et al. reference. Author-contribution initials D.A.M., J.S., E.R.B., R.G., J.E.M., J.P.S. agree with its six authors, and the body identifies their direct replications of Karataş and Cutright Studies 1, 2a, 2b, 3, and 5. Provenance header names Europe PMC fullTextXML for PMC11295048. This is an author-written primary replication letter/summary, not the detailed report requested by the page locators. DOI and full author byline are not printed in the supplied parse, so DOI identity is not independently confirmed. The letter points to ref. 4 for full results, materials, data, and code. That report and a PDF are not supplied. Related-article titles and abbreviated references in the parse are not treated as primary results. Only assigned unfinished fields were examined; other fields/sides are placeholders and must not overwrite verified data. The printed Study 3 r = 0.002 is the God-salience main effect on AI reliance, not the requested mediation through smallness/human imperfection. This letter does not give the mediator paths, indirect effects, target analytic sample, same-test p, or mediation-specific narrative verdict. The overall replication verdict cannot establish the mediation verdict. Pooled N = 4143 is not assigned as analytic N. No N sum or df-based derivation is made.
